Q5738.reason: Under the predominant-purpose test the UCC covers a mixed contract only when goods predominate, and here the $1,200 service agreement outweighs the $1,000 laptop, so UCC protection is not a default.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the moment of entry, and he entered to enjoy the party, so the later decision to steal does not make the entry burglarious; the unlocked door is irrelevant.

Q8324.reason: Repeated drug-driven dopamine surges cause post-synaptic receptor downregulation, so normal dopamine no longer satisfies the neuron and the patient feels compelled to seek more.
